chunks: My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: Sa'd bin Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad bin Muhammad, from his father, from Fadala, from Aban, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «(Ours is) The Religion of Allah, and which religion is better than that of Allah?» He said: It is Islam.

key_terms.صِبْغَةَ اللَّهِ: Religion of Allah / Dye of Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Sabghat Allah' (Religion of Allah) in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq transmits this concise exegesis through the chain of the Twelve Imams, where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) identifies 'Sabghat Allah' (the dye/coloring of Allah) as Islam, signifying the divine imprint of faith upon the believer. This interpretation underscores Islam not merely as a ritualistic practice but as the ultimate, pure state of being that distinguishes the faithful from other creeds. The metaphor of 'dye' implies a deep, enduring, and visible transformation of the soul's essence.
